typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		agency_code as string,
		agency_description as string,
		agency2_code as string,
		agency2_description as string,
		board_rpt_agency_code as string,
		board_rpt_agency_description as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT DISTINCT            agency_code,            agency_description, 		   agency2_code, 		   agency2_description, 		   agency3_code as board_rpt_agency_code , 		   agency3_description as board_rpt_agency_description 		       FROM    hr.vw_brg_department_site_business_unit',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> odbsdimagency	source(output(
		agency_key as long,
		agency_code as string,
		agency_description as string,
		agency2_code as string,
		agency2_description as string,
		board_rpt_agency_code as string,
		board_rpt_agency_description as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select * from hr.dim_agency',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LookupLKPTABLE
odbsdimagency,LookupLKPTABLE lookup(odbsdimagency@board_rpt_agency_code == LookupLKPTABLE@board_rpt_agency_code && odbsdimagency@agency_code == LookupLKPTABLE@agency_code && odbsdimagency@agency2_code == LookupLKPTABLE@agency2_code,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> Lookup
Lookup select(mapColumn(
		agency_code = odbsdimagency@agency_code,
		agency_description = odbsdimagency@agency_description,
		agency2_code = odbsdimagency@agency2_code,
		agency2_description = odbsdimagency@agency2_description,
		board_rpt_agency_code = odbsdimagency@board_rpt_agency_code,
		board_rpt_agency_description = odbsdimagency@board_rpt_agency_description,
		agency_key = agency_key
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> LookupSelect
LookupSelect split(isMatch(), disjoint: true) ~> LookupIsMatch@(Match,NotMatch)
LookupIsMatch@Match sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		{} = Param_0)) ~> updateexistingagencydescription
LookupIsMatch@NotMatch sink(input(
		agency2_description as string,
		board_rpt_agency_code as string,
		agency_code as string,
		agency2_code as string,
		agency_description as string,
		board_rpt_agency_description as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		agency2_description,
		board_rpt_agency_code,
		agency_code,
		agency2_code,
		agency_description,
		board_rpt_agency_description)) ~> oldbddimagency
